classification: proposed common semantic JSON codec; schema-only, no expected trace values; not actual Quint ITF wire

scalars.int: JSON number containing an exact nonnegative normal-example integer; not UInt128 decimal wire; no arbitrary precision/general overflow claim
scalars.InvocationStatus: JSON string NotInvoked, Waiting, Complete or BusinessRejected

containers.str -> int: JSON object; exact key set/value equality, object member order irrelevant; duplicate map keys not a supported input
containers.List[T]: JSON array; all elements retained in original order, including empty arrays
containers.record: JSON object retaining every field below; no omitted-field defaults or wildcard comparisons

adapter_contracts: Asset/duty/capture names and types are fixed external specimen context. They are not invented dynamic model fields; check them on the Rust side before projection.
FinancialFrame is represented separately at initialization and after the start prefix. Lifecycle initCase uses firstContinuation plus emptyInvocation. It is not a synthetic Waiting start invocation.
Lifecycle Observation.attemptedTotal is outside c and includes prefix work. It is not the committed count or a cap.
Completed c is an abstract post-state, not an emitted Rust Continuation. Rust Complete has no advanced field; adapter maps its existing segment to advanced=true and newContinuation=false.
Waiting.newContinuation denotes advanced replacement boundary, not allocation or pointer identity; false observation retains its actual input continuation.
Do not map ABI padded capture slots to the logical capture list.
Do not infer Rust typed statement/ExprId/per-step snapshot or decimal-wire correspondence from this codec.
No actual Quint trace serializer or decoder has yet been executed. A later ITF capture requires an explicit documented conversion into this proposed common codec.
